# Together

> > Together is an enterprise mentorship software platform that automates mentor-mentee matching, program management, and employee development at scale.

Together provides a comprehensive mentoring platform designed for organizations to build structured mentorship programs with AI-powered matching, integrated learning, and robust analytics. The platform supports diverse use cases including onboarding, diversity and inclusion, talent retention, and peer engagement.

## Key Topics

- Mentorship Platform
- AI Matching Algorithm
- Employee Development
- Mentoring Software
- Program Management
- Employee Engagement
- Diversity & Inclusion
- HRIS Integration
- Microsoft Teams
- Slack Integration
- LMS Integration
- Onboarding
- Peer Mentoring
- Analytics & Reporting
- Employee Matching

## Core Features

- [Matching Algorithm | Together Mentoring Software](https://www.togetherplatform.com/pairing-algorithm): Customizable AI matching algorithm for mentor-mentee pairing at scale
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.togetherplatform.com/artificial-intelligence): AI-powered features for profile matching and personalized learning
- [Development Programs](https://www.togetherplatform.com/development-programs): Customizable development programs with AI-powered matching at scale
- [Reporting](https://www.togetherplatform.com/reporting): Analytics dashboard tracking program metrics and ROI measurement
- [Tasks](https://www.togetherplatform.com/tasks): Task management with progress tracking and milestone automation
- [Emails & Comms](https://www.togetherplatform.com/emails-comms): Email automation and multi-channel messaging for program communication
- [Badges & Certificates](https://www.togetherplatform.com/badges-certificates): Recognition and achievement tracking with social sharing capabilities

## Engagement & Connection

- [Colleague Connect | Together Mentoring Software](https://www.togetherplatform.com/colleague-connect): Peer mentoring feature for employee engagement and diversity inclusion
- [Virtual Coffee Chats](https://www.togetherplatform.com/virtual-coffee-chats): Casual peer connection feature integrating with Teams, Slack, and Zoom
- [Events](https://www.togetherplatform.com/events-tool): Event management tool for workshops, panels, and lunch-and-learns
